items.author: AltcoinMiyagi
items.context: @AltcoinMiyagi (40.977 seguidores, en inglés): sostiene que $55K fue el piso del ciclo; cita $1,8B liquidados en un día, $11,3B de pérdidas realizadas en una semana, futuros a ~9x el volumen spot, MVRV que tocó techo en 2,29 este ciclo (vs. 2,93 en 2021 y 4,72 en 2017) y una caída de -56% frente al -77% del ciclo anterior. ~36 min, 3.934 vistas, 60 likes y solo 6 respuestas: cuenta mediana con un post que despega y que menciona MVRV y drawdowns, respondible con el índice de temperatura de mercado y los tiempos de recuperación de 2013.
items.suggested_text:
The leverage point is the part I'd weigh most. With futures running around 9x spot volume and the $59K–62K liquidation cluster wiped out, a big share of that selling was mechanical: margin calls, not holders giving up on the asset. That's a very different kind of supply than coins leaving long-term hands.

The valuation side reads just as cold. The market temperature index I built (MVRV, price vs. the 200-week average, drawdown from the ATH and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, 25% each) went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days. That's about as far from euphoria as the index gets.

What a bottom call doesn't settle is time. The two 2013 peaks took 210 and 1,177 days to be reclaimed. A smaller top can point to a shallower floor, but it says much less about how long the wait above it lasts.
